# Gmarket Sans

The bundled `GmarketSans-*.woff2` files are web-optimized subsets of the
official Gmarket Sans TTF distribution.

- Source: https://corp.gmarket.com/fonts/
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1
- Included weights: Light (300), Medium (500), Bold (700)

## Source Han Serif / 본명조 / 源ノ明朝

The bundled `SourceHanSerifKR-Panel.woff2` and
`SourceHanSerifJP-Panel.woff2` files are web-optimized subsets of Adobe's
official variable TTF WOFF2 release. The subsets contain the characters used
by the exhibition panels and keep the original variable weight axis.

- Source: https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-han-serif
- Version: 2.003
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1
- Korean source: `SourceHanSerifK-VF.ttf.woff2`
- Japanese source: `SourceHanSerif-VF.ttf.woff2`
- License copy: `SourceHanSerif-LICENSE.txt`
